# Hotel Flooring (hotelflooring.com.au)

> Hotel Flooring, a Premrest business (Premier Restorations Group). Hotel flooring supply and installation for occupied hotels, motels and serviced apartments in Melbourne, Sydney and Brisbane.

- Phone: 1300 207 915
- Email: projects@premrest.com.au
- Brand: Hotel Flooring, a Premrest business
- Coverage: Melbourne, Sydney, Brisbane, and nationally by arrangement
- Offer: supply-only or supply-and-install — broadloom, Axminster, carpet tiles, LVT/vinyl plank, sheet vinyl, entrance matting
- Method: staged room-by-room or floor-by-floor, night/off-peak, low noise and odour, guest-safe work areas
